technique_name: List five ways to reduce energy consumption.
description: Five ways to reduce energy consumption include: unplugging electronic devices when not in use; turning off the lights when leaving a room; switching to LED or CFL lightbulbs; installing motion-detecting light switches; and using natural light through larger windows and skylights. Additionally, replacing old appliances with energy-efficient models and installing weatherstripping to reduce air leaks can also help to reduce energy consumption.
